name: dokploy
description: Deploy to Dokploy: the CI publishes a Docker image on every release and the platform points the Dokploy application at that tag — one overlay for every language on the images-base build and runtime images; readiness checks (settings, image published, key accepted, application state); projects, applications and deployments as tools
author: actionplatform
needs: env: DOKPLOY_URL, DOKPLOY_API_KEY on a machine (the plugin's url and api_key options on the platform); AP_DOKPLOY_REGISTRY_USERNAME and AP_DOKPLOY_REGISTRY_PASSWORD for a private image
net: the Dokploy instance's url; the image registry (ghcr.io by default)
